newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to keep rupiah at reasonable level - paper.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to keep rupiah at reasonable level - paper.

text.p: Indonesia would keep the rupiah at reasonable levels against the dollar in a bid to maintain monetary stability, Bisnis Indonesia daily quoted Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad as saying on Thursday.
"I know the dollar is firming up now, however, we will keep the rupiah at as realistic a rate as possible," the minister was quoted as saying.
Mar'ie said the government was achieving monetary stability through a managed float which could also attract foreign investment and avoid a possible capital outflow.
Mar'ie did not give further details.
